zk06tui.name: README.TXT
zk06tui.content:
KESTREL STATION - GM TERMINAL KIT SHOWCASE

This drive is a short game that shows off what GM Terminal Kit can do.
Whenever you use a feature, a line starting with [KIT] explains it.

PLAY
  Your goal: get into the SECURITY folder and run the OVERRIDE program.
  Useful commands: DIR, DIR /A, CD <folder>, TYPE <file>, LOGIN <name>,
  MAIL, FIND <text>, RUN <program>. Type HELP for the full list.
  Start by looking around: CD PUBLIC

FEATURE REELS (no puzzle, just watch and listen)
  SOUNDS   every sound effect
  VOICE    the speaking voice
  EFFECTS  flash, shake and glitch
  THEMES   every look the terminal can have
  ASK      a question with branching answers
  GIF      an animated GIF as ASCII art
  ALL      all of the above

BEHIND THE SCENES
  Type GMMODE (or press Ctrl+Shift+G) to open the GM workspace, where
  this whole game was built without code:
  - Events, then Event map: how every step is wired together.
  - Answer key: every password and what it opens.
  - Double-click OVERRIDE.EXE to read its script.
  - Reset session puts everything back so you can play again.
  Then click Settings > New blank scenario and build your own.


STUCK?
  TYPE SOLUTION.TXT shows the full solution. It is a hidden file, so
  DIR and FIND leave it out.

81n19za.name: SOLUTION.TXT
81n19za.content:
KESTREL STATION - SOLUTION
  CD PUBLIC, DIR /A, TYPE STICKY.TXT    -> chen / perihelion
  LOGIN CHEN, password PERIHELION, MAIL 1 -> SECURITY password ORION
  CD \SECURITY (ORION), TYPE EYES_ONLY.TXT -> OVERRIDE password KESTREL7
  CD \, RUN OVERRIDE (KESTREL7), answer Y
  FIND SHUTDOWN, then type SHUTDOWN 4471 before the timer runs out.

2qaq6ts.content:
REACTOR MANUAL - SECTION 9: EMERGENCIES

In a reactor overload, type the emergency code at any terminal:

    SHUTDOWN 4471

Do not delay. Overload becomes meltdown in 90 seconds.

Please do not touch the reactor.

Chen, your SECURITY folder password has been reset to: ORION

The override password is in your eyes-only file. Read it once; it will not survive.
